channel.title: The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from all 55 African countries, every source cited.

item.title: Charcoal burning degrades environment, threatens food security
item.description: Sierra Leone's reliance on charcoal for cooking, due to limited electricity access, is driving deforestation and greenhouse gas emissions.

item.description: Women scavenging in abandoned mining pits in Sierra Leone report frequent sexual assaults and a lack of accountability from local camp authorities.

item.description: The office, constitutionally powerful, has historically served as a political cul-de-sac rather than a stepping stone to the presidency.
